title: Town Councils with Largest Number of Flats Eligible for Upgrading
what_it_is: Town Councils with Largest Number of Flats Eligible for Upgrading

sections.label: Town Councils HIP eligible flats
sections.summary: Aljunied-Hougang, Jurong-Clementi and Nee Soon are the three Town Councils with the most HIP-eligible flats, and HDB aims to finish selecting remaining eligible flats by FY2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The three Town Councils with the largest number of flats eligible for HIP are Aljunied-Hougang, Jurong-Clementi and Nee Soon.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB is working to complete the selection of the remaining HIP-eligible flats by FY2018.
